QuestInfo.name: A Mysterious Small Egg
QuestInfo.0: It sounds like someone is calling out my name. The dreamy eyes... the luscious purple hair... who are you?
QuestInfo.1: The fairy with the dreamy eyes and the flowing purple hair talks for a bit, but it's not understandable at all. After the fairy disappears, you find a #bMysterious Small Egg#k inside your inventory. The fairy said something about it being your friend... Anyway, you better go visit the fairy at #bEllinia#k, the town of Fairies.\r\n#b<Message from the Fairy>\nCome to Ellinia, home of green trees too tall to measure. I will wait for you here.
QuestInfo.2: The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a Mysterious Small Egg inside my inventory. Reliving the message the Fairy left for me, I went to the area and found Mar the Fairy hiding behind a huge bellflower. Mar mentioned something about being responsible for taking care of a living being, and then gave me a pet as a gift. The mysterious small egg turned out to be a Snail's egg.\r\nAlong with a message that this small snail can only be with me for 5 hours.

0.0: I put this small, precious life in your hands...Guard it with your life...
0.1: Looking after another life...That is the inevitable mission given to you...Follow the force that leads you to me.

yes.0: Try putting your hands inside your pockets. I think your friend has already found you. \n\n#bThe home of the green trees, which have boundless heights. Come to Ellinia. I will be waiting for you...

no.0: Do not turn away from your duties...

item.0: Oh, did you drop this snail egg? Come back when you find a mysterious small egg.
